description: Access tokens are RS256-signed with a persisted load-or-generate keypair in the storage root; the public key is published at `/.well-known/jwks.json`; the JWT claims/issuer (`user_id`/`sub`, `email`, `roles`, `iss: scenario-authenticator`, `aud`) match the carried-over contract so device-sync-hub's local verifier needs zero changes.

requirements.description: Access tokens must be signed with RS256 using a keypair that is loaded from storage if it exists or generated and persisted on first start, so tokens and JWKS survive service restarts. The JWKS endpoint /.well-known/jwks.json must publish the public key in standard JWK format. JWT claims must carry: sub (== user_id), email, roles, iss: 'scenario-authenticator', and aud matching the issuing realm. Algorithm must be locked to RS256; none and HS-family algorithms must be rejected at verify time.
requirements.title: RS256 Token Issuance with Persisted Keypair and JWKS Publication
